banks.title: Listening GT Section 4: Pelatihan Ergonomi Meja Kerja

questions.prompt:
Complete the notes. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.

Back and neck pain caused about ________ of all sick days.
questions.explanation_id: Pembicara menyebut nyeri punggung dan leher "accounted for about one third of all sick days".

questions.prompt: Screen position: the top of the screen should be level with your ________.
questions.explanation_id: Bukan tengah layar setinggi mata: "The top of the screen should be roughly level with your eyebrows."
Aturan praktisnya: "place the screen about an arm's length away".

questions.prompt: If your feet cannot reach the floor, ask for a ________.
questions.explanation_id: Pembicara menyarankan: "Ask for a footrest." Benda ini gratis bagi staf.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say about standing desks?
questions.explanation_id: Meja berdiri "are only helpful if you change position regularly, moving between sitting and standing".
options: They are the best solution for back pain
They are only useful if people change position regularly
They are too expensive for most companies
They cause more problems than they solve
correct_answers: They are only useful if people change position regularly

questions.prompt: The 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 ________ away for 20 seconds.
questions.explanation_id: Aturannya: "look at something twenty feet away for twenty seconds".

questions.prompt: Laptop users should raise the laptop on a stand and use a separate ________ and mouse.
questions.explanation_id: Pengguna laptop lebih dari satu jam per hari disarankan "use a separate keyboard and mouse".

questions.prompt: Choose TWO letters. Which TWO results of the pilot scheme does the speaker mention?
questions.explanation_id: Hasil uji coba: jumlah hari sakit karena nyeri punggung/leher turun dan staf melaporkan "higher job satisfaction". Produktivitas tidak diukur dan biaya justru naik dalam jangka pendek.
options: Fewer sick days due to back and neck pain
Lower costs in the short term
correct_answers: Fewer sick days due to back and neck pain

questions.prompt: Lighting: position the desk at ________ angles to the window.
questions.explanation_id: Pembicara menyarankan "position your desk at right angles to the window" agar cahaya datang dari samping.

questions.prompt: Individual workstation assessments are carried out by the ________ team.
questions.explanation_id: Penilaian dilakukan "by the facilities team, not by occupational health".
